map.输入各时段用气量（≥2 个）：平均=总和÷个数；高峰系数 Kmax=峰值÷平均、: Enter the gas consumption of each period (≥ 2 values): average = total ÷ count; peak factor Kmax = peak ÷ average, valley factor Kmin = valley ÷ average, peak-shaving demand = peak - average. Kmax<1.2 is very uniform, <1.5 fairly uniform, <2.0 fluctuates considerably, otherwise it is severe.
map.月用气 120/150/90/180/110/200（单位万m³）：平均 141: Monthly consumption 120/150/90/180/110/200 (in 10k m³): average 141.7, peak 200, valley 90, Kmax=1.41, Kmin=0.64, peak-shaving demand 58.3 — fairly uniform (Kmax<1.5); the gas holder should be sized from the peak-shaving volume plus a safety margin.
map.不均匀系数用来干什么？: What is the non-uniformity coefficient used for?
map.直接决定储气设施规模与气源调度弹性，Kmax 越大所需调峰能力越强，是储配站设计: It directly determines the scale of storage facilities and the flexibility of gas source dispatch: the larger Kmax, the stronger the required peak-shaving capability, making it a core input for storage and distribution station design.
map.小时系数通常比月系数大吗？: Is the hourly coefficient usually larger than the monthly coefficient?
map.是的，日内早晚高峰使小时不均匀系数往往明显大于月系数，调度应按最不利时段（小时）: Yes. Morning and evening peaks within a day make the hourly non-uniformity coefficient clearly larger than the monthly one, so dispatch should be checked against the worst-case period (hourly).
